parameters.name: hotel_meal_rate_inr

parameters.name: avg_fare_inr
parameters.description: Average one-way fare used for the approximate revenue-loss term.

parameters.name: compensation_block_le_1h_inr
parameters.description: VERIFY — DGCA CAR Sec 3 Series M Part IV cancellation compensation, block time <= 1 h.

parameters.name: reprotection_window_min
parameters.description: How far ahead re-accommodation onto later flights is searched (same day by default).

parameters.name: overnight_cutoff_min
parameters.description: Passengers not re-accommodated before this time count as stranded overnight.

parameters.name: vip_count
parameters.description: Example user-added column - number of VIP passengers (aggregate count).

objective_terms.name: forced_downstream_cancellations
objective_terms.description: Flights that could no longer operate because of this plan (aircraft position, crew, curfew).

objective_terms.name: propagated_delay
objective_terms.description: Delay minutes beyond what was already known, whether propagated or imposed by the plan.

objective_terms.name: next_wave_shortfall
objective_terms.description: Aircraft/crew missing for the next morning's first wave.

objective_terms.name: pax_cancelled
objective_terms.description: Passengers booked on flights this plan cancels.

objective_terms.name: pax_reprotect_delay
objective_terms.description: Passenger-hours until re-accommodated on later flights.

objective_terms.name: misconnects
objective_terms.description: Connecting passengers who miss an onward flight.

objective_terms.name: special_assistance_affected
objective_terms.description: Special-assistance passengers on affected flights (aggregate count, no PII).

objective_terms.name: high_value_affected
objective_terms.description: High-value passengers on affected flights (aggregate count).

objective_terms.name: compensation
objective_terms.description: DGCA CAR Sec 3 Series M Part IV compensation (defaults in parameters.yaml — VERIFY current CAR).

objective_terms.name: hotel_meal
objective_terms.description: Hotel and meal cost for stranded passengers.

objective_terms.name: crew_out_of_position
objective_terms.description: Crews left away from their next duty station.

objective_terms.name: revenue_loss
objective_terms.description: Approximate revenue at risk on cancelled flights.

objective_terms.name: buffer_consumed
objective_terms.description: Turnaround / FDP slack consumed by the plan.

objective_terms.name: tail_risk
objective_terms.description: (P90 - mean) of L1+L2 across sampled scenarios.

constraints.name: Aircraft continuity
constraints.description: A leg operates only if its tail is at the origin and ready by departure; cancelling a leg leaves the aircraft at that leg's origin.

constraints.name: Minimum turnaround
constraints.description: dep >= previous arrival + min turnaround (per type, hub/spoke).

constraints.name: Crew FDP and flight-time limits
constraints.description: Crew duty must stay inside the FDP limit for the report time and sector count.

constraints.name: Crew location
constraints.description: Crew must be at the origin station, or a standby at that station can be called out in time.

constraints.name: Crew qualification
constraints.description: Type rating required; CAT-III when low-visibility procedures are active.

constraints.name: Airport curfew
constraints.description: No departure/arrival inside a curfew window.

constraints.name: Slot / movement cap
constraints.description: Movements per hour <= capacity after disruption curves.

constraints.name: Stand / gate cap
constraints.description: Aircraft on ground at a station <= stand capacity (simple cap; decision D11).

constraints.name: Aircraft on ground (AOG)
constraints.description: A tail with status AOG cannot operate.

constraints.name: MEL restrictions
constraints.description: A tail cannot operate under conditions listed in its MEL restrictions (e.g. NO_CAT3).

constraints.name: Maintenance due
constraints.description: Tail must be at a maintenance base by maintenance_due_at.

constraints.name: Protected flights
constraints.description: Flights flagged protected are never cancellation candidates.

constraints.name: Delay bounds
constraints.description: DELAY actions above the bound are infeasible; delay pushing into curfew/FDP is caught by H4a/H3a.

constraints.name: Swap feasibility
constraints.description: Same type (or enough seats + rated crew), both tails at the station within the window, partner not AOG/MEL-blocked.

constraints.name: Passenger minimum connection time
constraints.description: Evaluated in the simulator; drives misconnects rather than excluding actions.

constraints.name: User rule - never cancel a flight with more than 50 VIPs
constraints.description: Example of a user-defined rule over an added attribute column (§15.2).
